response.sql: WITH matched_by_type AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(count) as avg_val FROM matched_by_type), filtered AS (SELECT m.count, oa.avg_val FROM matched_by_type m CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa WHERE m.count > oa.avg_val) SELECT AVG(count) as average_count, AVG(count - avg_val) as average_excess FROM filtered;
